data.offering_description: Sells product identification equipment, such as inkjet and laser coding and marking printers, to food, beverage, pharmaceutical and other manufacturers. Also sells water quality instruments, sensors and treatment systems to industrial customers and water utilities, mainly as equipment, consumables and service.

data.primary_products: coding and marking printers; consumable inks; water analysis instruments and sensors; UV disinfection systems; test reagents

data.primary_services: installation and maintenance; service contracts; instrument calibration

data.customer_segment: B2B: food and beverage makers, pharmaceutical and industrial manufacturers, environmental testing labs; B2G: municipal water utilities and government water agencies

data.end_markets: food and beverage; pharmaceuticals and life sciences; industrial manufacturing; water utilities; environmental testing

data.revenue_model: product sales: printers, instruments, UV systems and consumables sold to manufacturers and utilities; service fees: installation, maintenance and calibration for installed equipment

data.value_chain_position: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds printers, instruments and water treatment systems, sold to manufacturers and utilities; service provider: installs, maintains and calibrates equipment for existing customers

data.geography_served: global: Sells worldwide, with major operations in North America, Europe and Asia

data.specialization: diversified: two businesses: product identification (coding and marking) and water quality instruments and treatment

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: sales teams selling to large industrial accounts and utilities; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and dealers in many countries

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: drinking water and environmental testing standards, plus food and drug labeling and traceability rules, such as EPA and FDA requirements

data.offering_description: Provides water quality instrumentation, analytics and treatment solutions (Hach, Trojan Technologies, McCrometer, ChemTreat) and product identification equipment such as coding, marking, packaging and labeling systems (Videojet, Linx, Esko, X-Rite, Pantone). Sells to utilities, industrial plants, and consumer goods, food, beverage and pharmaceutical manufacturers, made in own factories with consumables and service.

data.primary_products: water testing instruments and reagents; UV disinfection systems; flow meters; industrial water treatment chemicals; industrial inkjet and laser coders and printers

data.primary_services: equipment servicing and maintenance; water treatment programs and monitoring; software support; calibration and color management services

data.customer_segment: B2B: industrial plants, food, beverage, pharma and consumer goods manufacturers, brand owners; B2G: municipal water and wastewater utilities and agencies

data.end_markets: municipal water and wastewater; industrial water; food and beverage; pharmaceuticals; consumer packaged goods

data.revenue_model: product sales: instruments, UV systems, meters, coders and printers, plus recurring consumables like reagents, inks and chemicals; service fees: installation, maintenance, calibration and service contracts; subscription: software and cloud analytics subscriptions

data.value_chain_position: OEM / manufacturer: builds instruments, treatment systems and coding equipment from purchased components, sold to utilities and manufacturers; service provider: water treatment programs and equipment servicing for industrial and municipal customers; software / platform: packaging workflow and color management software sold to brand owners and printers

P1.8.text: Our Water Quality companies help our customers manage, treat, purify, and protect the world’s waters, from municipal and wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans.

P1.10.text: Our Product Quality and Innovation companies help our customers protect food, medicine, and essential goods by enabling the traceability and authentication of billions of products that travel the global supply chain every day.

P1.14.text: Sustainability is woven deeply into the fabric of Veralto. From helping ensure clean drinking water to reducing packaging waste, we help protect precious resources and keep our global water and food supplies safe.

data.offering_description: Designs and manufactures electronic instruments and electromechanical devices for industrial, aerospace, defense, power, medical and laboratory customers. Sells mainly directly to original equipment makers and process plant operators, and through sales representatives.

data.primary_products: process and analytical instruments; test and calibration equipment; motors; motion control devices; sensors; power conversion equipment

data.customer_segment: B2B: aerospace and defense contractors, industrial equipment makers, process plant operators, medical device makers; B2G: defense and government agencies buying through prime contractors

data.end_markets: aerospace and defense; industrial automation; power generation; medical; laboratory and test

data.revenue_model: product sales: instruments, motors and electronic components sold to industrial and defense customers; service fees: calibration, repair and testing services for installed equipment

data.value_chain_position: OEM / manufacturer: builds instruments and electromechanical devices from purchased and in-house components, sold to OEMs and plant operators; component supplier: supplies motors, sensors and power components that other companies integrate into their equipment

data.geography_served: global: sells and operates across North America, Europe, Asia and other regions worldwide

data.specialization: diversified: two groups: electronic instruments and electromechanical devices, serving different customers

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling to OEMs, utilities and defense primes; agents / brokers: independent sales representatives and manufacturers' representative firms; distributors / dealers: industrial distributors selling standard motors and instruments

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: export controls and defense procurement rules, plus environmental and product safety regulations

data.specialization: related lines: Electronic Instruments Group and Electromechanical Group, both niche instruments and components
